title: Hilvan M5.3 (24 September 2026): rapid focal mechanism and Coulomb stress-transfer reproducibility archive
description: Reproducibility archive for the rapid first-hours analysis of USGS event us6000tx9u. Includes Jupyter notebooks, derived P-polarity/focal-mechanism tables, NP1/NP2 Coulomb grids, quality-control products, publication figures, provenance metadata, and raw waveform file manifest. Raw provider waveform bytes are not redistributed; users should retrieve them from the original FDSN/network providers. The focal mechanism is exploratory and underconstrained.
